findingClass: a stored documents.type disagrees with what the classifier says the URL/title is — the classifier fix was forward-only, so rows stored under the old wrong type stayed wrong and invisible
failThreshold: any documents row whose stored type has a permitted REFINEMENT to what the classifier returns (RHP->PROSPECTUS, ADDENDUM->CORRIGENDUM/PRICE_BAND_AD, BASIS_OF_ALLOTMENT->BASIS_OF_ALLOTMENT_AD). An UNRELATED reclassification is not a nightly FAIL — that is a source/classifier change for a human, surfaced by scraper/src/scripts/retype-misclassified-documents.ts
